list.title: Users
list.intro: Search and view accounts. Restricting and suspending happens in the detail view.
list.searchHint: Username, email, display name, slug or exact ID.
list.caption: Accounts, newest first
list.count: {count, plural, =0 {No accounts} one {One account} other {# accounts}}
list.countMore: {count, plural, one {One more account} other {# more accounts}}
list.emptyDescription: Accounts appear here as soon as someone signs up.
list.noMatchDescription: No account matches the search and filter. Change the search or reset the filter.

kindHints.MESSAGING: No messages and no new conversations.
kindHints.BOOKING: No appointment requests, no accepting and no counter-proposals. Cancelling remains possible.

detail.reportCount: {count, plural, =0 {No report against the account} one {One report against the account or its profile} other {# reports against the account or its profile}}
detail.suspendedText: Sign-in is blocked and the provider profile is not public until the suspension ends or someone lifts it.
detail.identityIntro: Only status and dates of the latest check; the platform stores no documents.
detail.rolesOnlySuper: Only a super admin assigns roles.
detail.restrictionsIntro: All measures against the account, newest first, with rule and reason.
detail.noRestrictions: No measure has been taken against this account yet.
detail.openAppeals: {count, plural, one {One open appeal} other {# open appeals}}
detail.securityIntro: The account’s last ten events, without addresses or devices.

lift.title: Lift: {kind}
lift.reasonHint: At least 10 characters. Goes into the audit log.

measures.title: Measures
measures.restrictIntro: The account stays usable but loses messages or appointments.
measures.ruleHint: Which rule is the measure based on?
measures.reasonHint: At least 10 characters. The person concerned sees it in their settings.
measures.untilHint: Without an end, the measure applies until someone lifts it. It ends at 23:59 Zurich time.
measures.suspendIntro: Ends all sessions, blocks sign-in and takes the provider profile out of public view.
measures.suspended: The account is suspended. All sessions have ended.
measures.confirmText: All sessions end immediately, sign-in is blocked and the provider profile is no longer public. An appeal is possible via the contact form. Lifting restores the profile.

rolesForm.rolesHint: Without ticks the account has no internal role and no admin access.
rolesForm.reasonHint: At least 10 characters. Goes into the audit log with the roles before and after.

providers.title: Providers
providers.intro: All provider profiles with status, latest review and regions. Reviewing happens in Verifications.
providers.searchHint: Display name, slug, username or exact ID.
providers.caption: Provider profiles, newest first
providers.count: {count, plural, =0 {No profiles} one {One profile} other {# profiles}}
providers.emptyDescription: Profiles appear here as soon as providers start onboarding.
providers.noMatchDescription: No profile matches the search and status. Change the search or reset the filter.
